name: terminal-nav
description: Session and worktree navigator for Claude Code on macOS. Provides awareness of active sessions across terminals, projects, and worktrees with real-time state (working/blocked/idle). List, jump between, spawn new sessions, and transfer work across worktrees.
author: jorge.uriarte@omelas.net

installation.instructions: After installation, run: nav --setup (will add hooks to ~/.claude/settings.json)

subcommands.name: list
subcommands.description: List all active Claude Code sessions

subcommands.name: jump
subcommands.description: Jump to a session by project or worktree pattern

subcommands.name: spawn
subcommands.description: Spawn a new Claude Code session

subcommands.name: worktrees
subcommands.description: List worktrees in a project with session status
